title: Grateful Dead Live at Springfield Civic Center Arena on 1973-03-28
lineage: Dat -> SEK'D Prodif Plus -> Samplitude Professional v8.01 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy second set highlighted by an epic Dark Star and pristine WRS prelude.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its exquisite, crystal‑clear sound quality, typical of a soundboard source.  Listeners rave about the soaring Dark Star, the powerful WR Prelude, and tight performances from the band that make this second set feel like a 1973 highlight reel.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong, enthusiastic comments about both the musical performance (especially Dark Star and WRS sections) and the recording quality outweigh the sparse negative or neutral remarks.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the audio as "exquisite" and note no drop‑outs or muddiness; the mix is clear and well balanced.

standout_songs: WR Prelude > Dark Star > Eyes > Daybreak
show_quality.setlist_flow: Second‑set opener with a tight WR Prelude segues into an expansive Dark Star, followed by classic mid‑tempo numbers that keep the momentum high.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for his intense guitar work and vocal contributions, especially during the lengthy Dark Star.
band_member_comments.Bob: Noted for nailing "Me & My Uncle" and delivering strong rhythm/lead interplay.
